page_title: TOR 2-2 PIS | Torino v Pisa 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) has tested the patience of referee Alberto Arena and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Ivan Ilic (Torino) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alberto Arena blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
88' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Adrian Semper comes off his line to gather the ball.
87' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alberto Arena blows for a foul.
86' Duvan Zapata (Torino) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
85' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) swings in a cross from the corner, but Adrian Semper reads it well and gathers the ball.
84' Pisa are ruled offside.
83' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Pisa).
83' That's the end of the game for Isak Vural, who is replaced by Marius Marin (Pisa).
82' 3:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
79' A player from Pisa commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
78' Substitution. Giovanni Simeone walks off the pitch and Duvan Zapata (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
76' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

75' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Alberto Paleari makes a great save to stop his effort.
74' Henrik Meister (Pisa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
73' Substitution. Valentino Lazaro will be replaced by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino).
73' A rebound falls kindly for Michel Aebischer (Pisa), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
71' The ball is cleared after Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
69' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
68' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Torino will have a corner.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adrien Tameze (Torino) comes onto the pitch for Guillermo Maripan.
66' Substitution. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Che Adams walks off.
66' Here is a change. Idrissa Toure is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to M'Bala Nzola (Pisa).
65' Substitution. Stefano Moreo makes way for Samuele Angori (Pisa).
65' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) makes a strong challenge and Alberto Arena blows for a foul.
64' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) takes the corner.
62' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
61' Alberto Arena blows the whistle, Marcus Pedersen (Torino) is penalised for a foul.
61' Torino are seeing far more of the ball now.
59' Cesare Casadei (Torino) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' Ivan Ilic (Torino) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
54' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
54' Poor challenge! Ivan Ilic (Torino) is penalised for tripping and Alberto Arena blows his whistle.
53' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Adrian Semper scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
51' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
50' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Torino earn a corner.
50' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
47' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
46' Half-time substitution. Nikola Vlasic is replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Torino).
46' Half-time substitution. Alberto Gilardino decided to make a change. Malthe Hojholt is replaced by Michel Aebischer (Pisa).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
46' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. Pisa will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' 2 - 2 Goal! Che Adams (Torino) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 2:2.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Referee Alberto Arena has finally had enough of Marco Baroni and gives him a straight RED CARD!
42' 1 - 2 Giovanni Simeone (Torino) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
40' Flag up against Giovanni Simeone (Torino). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
40' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Che Adams (Torino) heads on.
40' Saul Coco (Torino) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
39' The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) was quite harsh and Alberto Arena didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
35' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
34' Looks like Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
33' A player from Torino commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
32' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
31' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) jumps into a tackle and Alberto Arena signals a foul.
29' 0 - 2 Goal! Stefano Moreo (Pisa) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Alberto Paleari to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
29' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
29' Referee Alberto Arena is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Pisa!
28' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Pisa using VAR. Let's see what happens.
27' Cesare Casadei (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alberto Arena had an easy-decision to make.
27' Alberto Arena blows his whistle after Cesare Casadei (Torino) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Pisa are given a penalty!
27' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) latched on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his strike isn't accurate at all and the ball goes way wide of the left post.
24' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
22' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Cesare Casadei (Torino) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
22' Saul Coco (Torino) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' Saul Coco (Torino) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
19' Half-chance! Idrissa Toure (Pisa) plays a pass into the box, but Alberto Paleari reacts well to snuff out the attack.
18' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alberto Arena stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
16' Referee Alberto Arena signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Pisa players have a reason to celebrate!
14' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Pisa players aren’t happy.
13' 0 - 1 Stefano Moreo (Pisa) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
13' OFF THE BAR! Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.
11' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.

8' Great first touch by Che Adams (Torino) after collecting a pass deep inside the box. He smashes the ball to the bottom right corner, but the keeper makes a brilliant reflex save and pushes it onto the post!
7' Cesare Casadei (Torino) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
5' Great touch by Che Adams (Torino) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
3' Isak Vural (Pisa) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Pisa will take the kick-off.
Alberto Arena got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
